section_label: Audit publication/reporting, risk profiling for non-individual clients, website requirements, conduct measures (free trials, fees, complaints display), and IAASB/RAASB enlistment

obligations.title: Publish adverse audit findings on website
obligations.key_phrase: publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof

obligations.title: Provide compliance audit report to clients
obligations.key_phrase: IA shall provide the compliance audit report to its clients

obligations.title: Comply with additional audit requirements from FY2025
obligations.key_phrase: additional audit requirements under this clause starting with audit report for financial year ending March 31, 2025

obligations.title: Use investment policy for non-individual client risk profiling
obligations.key_phrase: use the investment policy as approved by board/management team of such non-individual clients

obligations.title: Discretion not to onboard if no investment policy available
obligations.key_phrase: discretion not to onboard non-individual clients if they are unable to do risk profiling

obligations.title: Maintain a functional website
obligations.key_phrase: investment adviser shall maintain a functional website, which shall contain the details as may be specified by SEBI

obligations.title: Display specified details prominently across channels
obligations.key_phrase: shall display the following information prominently on its website, mobile app, printed or electronic materials

obligations.title: Confirm website details to IAASB by June 30, 2025
obligations.key_phrase: Existing IAs, as on January 8, 2025, shall confirm the details of its website to IAASB latest by June 30, 2025

obligations.title: No free trials for products/services
obligations.key_phrase: IAs shall not provide free trial for any products/services to prospective clients

obligations.title: No part/advance payments accepted
obligations.key_phrase: shall not accept part payments (where some part of the fee is paid in advance)

obligations.title: Complete risk profile before giving advice
obligations.key_phrase: Complete the risk profile of the client based on information provided by the client

obligations.title: Obtain client consent on completed risk profile
obligations.key_phrase: Obtain consent of the client on completed risk profile either through registered email or physical document

obligations.title: Accept fees only via specified banking channels
obligations.key_phrase: accept fees strictly by account payee crossed cheques / demand draft or by way of direct credit

obligations.title: No cash deposits accepted for fees
obligations.key_phrase: IAs shall not accept cash deposits

obligations.title: Display complaints status on homepage monthly
obligations.key_phrase: display the following information on the homepage (without scrolling) of their website/mobile app

obligations.title: RA/IA applicant must be enlisted with RAASB/IAASB
obligations.key_phrase: applicant seeking registration as RA and IA is required to be enlisted with RAASB and IAASB respectively
